title: Global Bungee Rectangular Flip-Top Table — Spider Legs with Casters
body_html:
Reconfigure an entire room in minutes — no tools, no fuss, just flip, roll and connect.

The Global Bungee flip-top table pairs a spider-leg base on locking casters with a flip-top surface that folds vertically for nesting and storage. Sized for rectangular tops from 42" to 72" wide in 24" and 30" depths, Bungee uses simple cords to join and separate tables tool-free, while a bubble-mold split edge self-aligns adjoining surfaces for clean, seamless layouts. Built in Canada, it is an affordable, durable foundation for spaces that move from classroom rows to collaborative clusters and back again.

Key features

  • Flip-top mechanism folds the surface vertically for nesting and compact storage
  • Tool-free reconfiguration using Bungee cords to join and separate tables
  • Spider-leg base on casters for fast repositioning between classroom, training and boardroom layouts
  • Bubble-mold split edge self-aligns adjoining tables and minimizes seams
  • Optional modesty panels available on select models
  • Available in fixed or flip-top surfaces across a wide range of shapes

Who it’s for

Classrooms, training rooms and boardrooms in education, municipal and broader public sector environments that need flexible, fast-to-reconfigure meeting surfaces.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
